rationale: Roberts is likely to keep assignment and write a narrow conflict-preemption opinion grounded in Foster’s “consummation” language and the distinction between post-day tabulation and post-day legal effectiveness. Separate writings are most likely from Kagan (principal dissent) with possible Sotomayor/Jackson joins or add-ons, and from Thomas/Gorsuch/Alito to emphasize textualism and the negative implication from Congress’s express absentee exceptions (e.g., UOCAVA).
